facts.fact: Zambia's Ministry of Technology and Science says the Cyber Security Bill (N.A.B. 29/2024) and Cyber Crimes Bill (N.A.B. 30/2024) were amended in eight clauses and a Notice of Amendments issued to Parliament for resubmission.
facts.system: Cyber Security Bill and Cyber Crimes Bill

facts.fact: The ministry refers to the review of the Cyber Security and Cybercrimes Act No. 2 of 2021, which it says it consulted on in 2022 and 2024.
facts.system: Cyber Security and Cybercrimes Act No. 2 of 2021

systems.system: Cyber Security and Cybercrimes Act No. 2 of 2021

ZMB.note: Civil-society concern over the bills is stated without naming a group, and nothing on cuts or punishment.

facts.fact: The ministry says a Technical Committee of government and civil society representatives met on 26 February, 10 March and 11 March 2025 on civil society concerns about the Cyber Security Bill and Cyber Crimes Bill, after the President deferred both.
facts.system: Technical Committee on the cyber bills

facts.fact: The ministry's published statement says eight clauses were amended after the consultations and a Notice of Amendments issued to Parliament, and claims 98 percent of concerns were resolved.
facts.system: Technical Committee on the cyber bills

ZMB.note: The Technical Committee's members are not named and it gave no stated opinion as a standing body, so no standing fact.
